note: Implement reversible platform suspension as a lifecycle-orthogonal Application availability gate. Add independent OCC, exact suspend/restore permissions, atomic audit and durable alert outbox, keep ownership and dependent configuration intact, block Catalog/runtime/Tester Join and all five OAuth provider methods, and preserve existing online snapshot/delegation residual bounds. Restore only removes the platform gate and never repairs or enables invalid dependent configuration.
